cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your plate is back in the cupboard. Pattern facing forward, please; presentation starts before the table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our plates are plain. That one has flowers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this is the serving plate. We distinguish serving pieces from place settings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need all six plain plates for Sunday. Where's the sixth?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll supply six matching floral ones. Keep the plain ones together at the back; don't mix two services while I'm making this consistent.

reason: Make A expert classification fail against B exact missing-plate question, then restore apparent consistency with a full replacement while still hiding the original loss.
